name: Kate Burns
story: Kate Burns was one of three Tonkin & Taylor practitioners named by Esri as recipients of the 2012 Eagle Technology Excellence in GIS Award for the Canterbury Earthquake Residential Land Damage application. Esri's account of the Auckland Asia Pacific User Conference names James Lyth and Kate Williams alongside her.
